On partial delivery: nano-invoice uses one invoice per order-key, so a partial delivery is a separate invoice per portion, each with its own tagged amount; the seller closes an invoice only when the full tagged amount lands. Refunds when acceptance stays unknown go to the account that actually paid (read from the block link, not a claimed payer), and faucet/self-drips matching the amount are excluded because source account must differ from destination.
